Application Data.NAME: Mountain Peak Outfitters
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Mountain Peak Outfitters specializes in the retail of camping and outdoor equipment, including tents, hiking gear, and related accessories. We also offer limited outdoor workshops focused on safety and proper gear usage, ensuring all instructors are properly insured and safety plans are in place. Our store prioritizes customer safety through organized layouts to minimize injury risks and has implemented robust cyber controls for our online sales platform. Additionally, we comply with storage regulations for any hazardous materials used in our operations.
Application Data.GENERAL INFO QUESTIONS:
1. **No** - We do not store, treat, discharge, apply, dispose of, or transport hazardous materials as our operations focus on camping and outdoor equipment sales.
   
2. **No** - We do not sponsor athletic teams; our business is strictly retail-focused.

3. **Yes** - Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. We have a designated team member who verifies all certificates from subcontractors prior to any work.

4. **No** - No applicant associated with the business has been indicted or convicted of crimes related to fraud, bribery, arson, or similar offenses.

5. **No** - We have not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years.

6. **No** - We do not lease employees to or from other employers; all employees are directly hired by our business.

7. **Yes** - We carry Workers Compensation insurance to cover our employees in case of any work-related injuries.

8. **No** - We do not own or operate any other business; our focus is solely on camping and outdoor equipment retail.

9. **No** - We do not have any other insurance with this company; our current policy is our only engagement with them.

10. **No** - We are not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; we solely sell equipment and gear.

11. **No** - We do not rent or loan equipment to others; all products are sold directly to customers.

12. **No** - The applicant has not had any foreclosures, repossessions, bankruptcies, judgments, or liens in the past five years.

13. **Yes** - There is some exposure to flammables from camping fuel and propane storage, but we comply with all safety regulations for storage.

14. **No** - There is no exposure to catastrophic events that would affect our business operations significantly.

15. **No** - There have been no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse, molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring.

16. **No** - There are no uncorrected fire code violations; we adhere to all fire safety regulations.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 08/15/2022; Cause: Water damage from a leaky roof; Amount: $5,000.00; Status: Closed
